items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Judy was one of the influences for me, Judy Garland.

ctx.x: The use of the hands, your gestures, how you do when you’re on stage – that came out of acting class, you think? Or you came out of – or were you influenced by people like Judy Garland or Betty Carter? Or by then you had developed your own style?
Judy was one of the influences for me, Judy Garland. I forget the kid that was with her.
